newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan stock exchange ends session flat.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan stock exchange ends session flat.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange ended its two-hour session on Wednesday virtually unchanged as investors waited for company results, stockbrokers said.
The all-share index closed at 436.08 points from 436.04 points on Tuesday.

"The bourse index was almost unchanged due mainly to stagnation of the largest capitalisation shares value... Investors are awaiting publication of listed companies' first results," an analyst at Upline Securities said.
ONA Group, Morocco's largest private conglomerate, remained stable at 500 dirhams compared with the previous session.
ONA has diversified stakes in more than 100 companies and a capitalisation of more than 8.3 billion dirhams.
Societe Nationale d'Investissment, the second largest conglomerate was unchanged at 530 dirhams.
Traded volume on the official market was 26.4 million, down from 64.8 million on Tuesday.
